arxiv-2212-04445.title: Non-tightness in class theory and second-order arithmetic Thanks: We thank the anonymous referee for their comments. This research was supported by FCT through CIDMA and projects UIDB/04106/2020 and UIDP/04106/2020.
arxiv-2212-04445.creator: Alfredo Roque Freire, Kameryn J. Williams
arxiv-2212-04445.description: Abstract . A theory T T is tight if different deductively closed extensions of T T (in the same language) cannot be bi-interpretable. Many well-studied foundational theories are tight, including 𝖯𝖠 \mathsf{PA} [ Vis06 ] , 𝖹𝖥 \mathsf{ZF} , 𝖹 2 \mathsf{Z}_{2} , and 𝖪𝖬 \mathsf{KM} [ Ena16 ] .

arxiv-2301-13079.title: Fast Combinatorial Algorithms for Min Max Correlation Clustering
arxiv-2301-13079.creator: Sami DaviesBenjamin Moseley, Heather Newman
arxiv-2301-13079.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sami DaviesBenjamin Moseley, Heather Newman. We introduce fast algorithms for correlation clustering with respect to the Min Max objective that provide constant factor approximations on complete graphs. Our algorithms are the first purely combinatorial approximation algorithms for this problem. We construct a novel semi-metric on the set of vertices, which we call the correlation metric, that indicates to our clustering algorithms whether pairs of nodes should be in the same cluster.

arxiv-2309-15099.title: Seimei KOOLS-IFU mapping of the gas and dust distributions in Galactic PNe: Unveiling the origin and evolution of Galactic halo PN H4-1
arxiv-2309-15099.creator: Masaaki Otsuka, Toshiya Ueta, Akito Tajitsu
arxiv-2309-15099.description: Abstract H4-1 is a planetary nebula (PN) located in the Galactic halo, and is notably carbon-rich and one of the most metal-deficient PNe in the Milky Way. To unveil its progenitor evolution through the accurate measurement of the gas mass, we conducted a comprehensive investigation of H4-1, using the newly obtained Seimei/KOOLS-IFU spectra and multiwavelength spectro-photometry data.

arxiv-2310-06134.title: Recovering 21cm monopole signals without smoothness
arxiv-2310-06134.creator: Rugved Pund 1,2∗, Anže Slosar 1,2, Aaron Parsons 3
arxiv-2310-06134.description: Abstract We expect the monopole signal at the lowest frequencies below 100 100\, MHz to be composed of two components: the deep Rayleigh-Jeans tail of the cosmic microwave background and two distinct features: the dark ages trough at ∼ 17 \sim 17\, MHz and the cosmic dawn trough at ∼ 75 \sim 75\, Mhz.

arxiv-2406-00710.title: Non-Isomorphic Groups with Isomorphic Power and Commuting Graphs
arxiv-2406-00710.creator: Surbhi, Geetha Venkataraman
arxiv-2406-00710.description: Abstract The power graph of a group G G is a graph with vertex set G G , in which two vertices are adjacent if one is some power of the other. In the commuting graph, with G G as the vertex set, two vertices are joined by an edge if they commute in G G .

arxiv-2406-03218.title: A case study of gas impacted by black-hole jets with the JWST: outflows, bow shocks, and high excitation of the gas in the galaxy IC5063
arxiv-2406-03218.creator: Kalliopi M. Dasyra, Georgios F. Paraschos, Francoise Combes, Polychronis Patapis, George Helou, Michalis Papachristou, Juan-Antonio Fernandez-Ontiveros, Thomas G. Bisbas, Luigi Spinoglio, Lee Armus, Matthew Malkan
arxiv-2406-03218.description: Abstract We present James Webb Space Telescope MIRI data of the inner ∼ \sim 3 × \times 2kpc 2 of the galaxy IC5063, in which the jets of a supermassive black hole interact with the gaseous disk they are crossing.

arxiv-2409-02764.title: Multiple Local and Global Bifurcations and Their Role in Quorum Sensing Dynamics
arxiv-2409-02764.creator: Mariana Harris, Viviana Rivera–Estay, Pablo Aguirre, Víctor F. Breña–Medina
arxiv-2409-02764.description: Abstract Quorum sensing governs bacterial communication, playing a crucial role in regulating population behaviour. We propose a mathematical model that uncovers chaotic dynamics within quorum sensing networks, highlighting challenges to predictability. The model explores interactions between autoinducers and two bacterial subtypes, revealing oscillatory dynamics in both a constant autoinducer sub-model and the full three-component model.

arxiv-2409-05291.title: Towards Fast Rates for Federated and Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2409-05291.creator: Feng Zhu, Robert W. Heath Jr, Aritra Mitra
arxiv-2409-05291.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Feng Zhu, Robert W. Heath Jr, Aritra Mitra. We consider a setting involving N N agents, where each agent interacts with an environment modeled as a Markov Decision Process (MDP). The agents’ MDPs differ in their reward functions, capturing heterogeneous objectives/tasks. The collective goal of the agents is to communicate intermittently via a central server to find a policy that maximizes the average of long-term cumulative rewards across environments.

arxiv-2501-09562.title: Rethinking cloud abstractions for tenant-provider cooperative optimization of AI workloads
arxiv-2501-09562.creator: Marco Canini, Ricardo Bianchini, Íñigo Goiri, Dejan Kostić, Peter Pietzuch
arxiv-2501-09562.description: Abstract . AI workloads, often hosted in multi-tenant cloud environments, require vast computational resources but suffer inefficiencies due to limited tenant-provider coordination. Tenants lack infrastructure insights, while providers lack workload details to optimize tasks like partitioning, scheduling, and fault tolerance. We propose the HarmonAIze project to redefine cloud abstractions, enabling cooperative optimization for improved performance, efficiency, resiliency, and sustainability.

arxiv-2504-03297.title: Chemomechanical motility modes of partially wetting liquid droplets
arxiv-2504-03297.creator: Florian Voss, Uwe Thiele
arxiv-2504-03297.description: Abstract We consider a simple thermodynamically consistent model that captures the self-organized chemomechanical coupling resulting from the interplay between autocatalytically reacting surfactants, the Marangoni effect and wetting dynamics. An ambient bath of surfactant acts as a chemostat and provides the system with chemical fuel, thereby driving it away from thermodynamic equilibrium.

pmc-12672784.title: Ravulizumab exposure in early pregnancy
pmc-12672784.creator: Wolfgang Füreder, Sonja Granser, Andreas Repa, Alex Farr
pmc-12672784.description: Before complement inhibitors were available, pregnancy in women with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) was associated with considerable mortality, mainly due to thromboembolism. Eculizumab has now largely been replaced by the longer acting ravulizumab in non-pregnant PNH patients.

pmc-13425480.description: Diego Rivera (1886–1957) painted his first mural La Creación (Creation, 1922–1923) with an encaustic painting technique, which was traditionally utilized by the ancient Greeks and typically employed beeswax and other resins. Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
